description: Build all application screens using expo-router file-based routing: onboarding flow, home dashboard, breathing session screen (with the enhanced breathing animation), stats/history screen, and settings screen. Each screen uses the theme system and shared UI components from FEAT-002.
steps: Create app/onboarding.jsx - A beautiful welcome/onboarding screen with: app name and tagline with fade-in animation, 2-3 swipeable benefit cards (reduce stress, improve focus, better sleep) with illustrations using gradient shapes, a 'Get Started' button that navigates to home and marks onboarding complete in AsyncStorage
Create app/(tabs)/_layout.jsx - Tab navigation layout with custom styled tab bar (glassmorphism effect, icons from @expo/vector-icons), 4 tabs: Home, Breathe, Stats, Settings

Create app/(tabs)/index.jsx (Home tab) - Dashboard with: greeting based on time of day, current streak display with flame icon, quick-start cards for favorite patterns, daily goal progress ring, recent session summary, motivational quote that changes daily

Create app/(tabs)/breathe.jsx (Breathe tab) - The main breathing session screen with: enhanced BreathingVisual animation (keep the lung/orb concept but add gradient rings and pulse effects using react-native-reanimated), pattern selector as horizontal scrollable cards, session duration picker (1/3/5/10 minutes or infinite), phase display with large countdown and circular progress, play/pause/reset controls with haptic feedback, session complete celebration animation with confetti-like particles

Create app/(tabs)/stats.jsx (Stats tab) - Statistics and history screen with: total sessions count, total minutes breathed, current/longest streak with calendar heat map visualization, weekly chart showing session frequency (simple bar chart using Views), achievement badges grid (first session, 7-day streak, 30-day streak, 100 sessions, night owl, early bird), session history list with date/pattern/duration

Create app/(tabs)/settings.jsx (Settings tab) - Settings screen with: theme toggle (dark/light) with live preview, haptic feedback toggle, sound toggle, daily reminder time picker, about section with version, reset data option with confirmation alert
Update app/index.jsx to check onboarding status from AsyncStorage and redirect to either onboarding or (tabs)/index accordingly
Update app/_layout.jsx to define all routes in the Stack navigator

Create src/components/breathing/EnhancedBreathingVisual.jsx - Revamped breathing animation using react-native-reanimated with: concentric gradient rings that expand/contract, particle orbs that orbit during breathing, smooth color transitions between phases (teal for inhale, purple for hold, warm orange for exhale), glow effects that intensify with breath
Create src/components/breathing/SessionControls.jsx - Play/pause/reset button group with animated transitions and haptic feedback
Create src/components/breathing/PatternCard.jsx - Horizontal scrollable pattern selection card with pattern name, timing info, and difficulty indicator
Expand src/constants/patterns.js to add more patterns: Energizing (2-2-4-0), Deep Calm (5-5-5-5), Coherent (5-0-5-0), Wim Hof (2-0-2-10), 2-1-4 (beginner), and allow custom pattern creation
acceptance_criteria: All 6 screens render without errors (onboarding, home, breathe, stats, settings, index redirect)
Tab navigation works between Home, Breathe, Stats, and Settings
Onboarding flow shows on first launch, then redirects to tabs
Breathing session screen has the enhanced animation with pattern selection and timer
Stats screen shows session history and achievements from SessionContext
Settings screen allows toggling theme, haptics, and sounds
8 breathing patterns available including the original 3
verification: Run npx expo export --platform web and confirm exit code 0
